apiKey.title: August API Key
apiKey.description: August/Yale API key (a.k.a. kease API key) used to authenticate against the August cloud.

installID.title: Install ID
installID.description: A stable, unique installation id (UUID). Generate once and keep it constant.

augustID.title: August ID
augustID.description: Your August account email address or phone number.

validationCode.title: 2FA Validation Code
validationCode.description: Leave empty on first run to request a 6-digit code sent to your August ID. Then enter the code here and restart to validate the session.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll the August cloud for lock/door/battery state.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the locks in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the locks will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The locks in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging.
